messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Multi group Longitudinal SEM
parts: Can you please give an example?

The lavaan web site provides examples in the tutorial pages.  This page provides information about multigroup modeling:

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/groups.html

Longitudinal models simply have multiple factors in the same model, which represent the same factor measured at different occasions.  You can find other examples of sem using lavaan in this textbook's website:

http://blogs.baylor.edu/rlatentvariable/sample-page/r-syntax/

Terry
